validation: Unity 6000.3.20f1 and com.unity.profiling.core 1.0.3 expose the frozen generic marker, delta counter, Network category and recorder APIs.
Session delivery is synchronous, LIFO and finally-paired, so direct marker Begin/End mapping is feasible.
Counter mappings are honest process-wide delta streams; Declines does not claim packet loss and receive idle is excluded.
The optional package dependency graph, worker ownership and post-Accepted orchestrator manifest integration are coherent.
No blocking contract changes were requested.
